title: Booker T & Benoit’s best-of-seven contest
summary: Booker T and Chris Benoit compete for a Television title opportunity. A disputed final forces an extra match, giving their competitive series a payoff built around earning a clear winner.

chapters.title: Interference spoils the deciding match
chapters.result: Booker wins by disqualification after Hart interferes.
chapters.context: The disputed finish leads to a replacement decider rather than a clean conclusion to the series.

chapters.title: Booker wins the decider and the title
chapters.result: Booker defeats Benoit, then beats Finlay for the Television championship.
chapters.context: The additional match resolves the series and gives Booker a second successful test the same night.
